copy.wiringNote: An Arduino-shield form factor, so it is wired with jumpers rather than seated: thirteen lines for the panel, and no touch header at all. The resistive sheet has no controller and borrows four of those same lines; the two it reads (LCD_CS and LCD_RS) must sit on ADC1 - on ADC2 a press reads fine until something enables Wi-Fi. This product ships different controllers between revisions under identical silkscreen; the driver targets the ILI9341 one.
